purpose: Defines the normative state model and permitted transitions for published ToC versions, ToC build/rebuild runs, and DLID embedding runs, with tables and diagrams.
summary: Separation of published ToC state from build run progress; "rebuild needed" and "referent missing" are judgments, not states
Stateless operations: search, DLID resolution and checks never change managed state
Published ToC transitions P-01 to P-03: unbuilt to published, republish, failure keeps the prior state
Build run transitions B-01 to B-09 from started through scope, IDs, changes, data, references, candidate, finished or failed
Failure handling: no candidate published, old ToC kept, no automatic retry, explicit rerun
Document information confirmed so far is not rolled back when a build fails
Reference check results (match, path mismatch, missing in directory) and their freshness
DLID embedding run transitions E-01 to E-07 including original confirmation for duplicates
Rejection of transitions not in the table, with mermaid state diagrams as visualization
tasks: Implementing ToC build or rebuild state handling
Reviewing design consistency of state and failure behavior
Designing failure reporting and rerun behavior
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
